language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: H1 FY27 profit is the one financial line not yet disclosed, and the pre-released mix (revenue +GBP3.1m, third-party manufacturing +19%, licensing +13% with accelerated income, ~GBP1m annualised central savings completed in H2 FY26) points to adjusted PBT above H1 FY26's GBP2.2m, but it lands inside the reiterated GBP6.5m FY guide and the footnote that GBP3.6m of the GBP4.9m licensing is accelerated IFRS 15 income invites a quality-of-earnings discount.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Interim results days: +2.36% (Oct 2023), -16.34% (Oct 2024), +3.16% (Oct 2025); the H1 trading update this year moved +1.94%.

findings.finding: The board pulled the interims forward nine days, from Wednesday 21 October (set in the 7 August RNS) to Monday 12 October, two weeks after a 14% holder requisitioned a GM to remove the chair -- a board defending itself has every incentive to front-load the strongest possible results, outlook and shareholder-return message before its circular.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior date change or contested GM at SDG on record in the Investegate history (751 RNS back to before 2023).

findings.finding: Closest listed peer Colefax reported fabric sales to 18 September 2026 with US +14.0% and UK -4.5%, consistent with SDG's H1 shape and pointing to continued US strength in SDG's first H2 weeks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SDG's last current-trading lines: H1 TU +1.94%, FY TU Feb 2026 +16.67%, Jan 2025 TU -12.04% -- current trading drives this name.

findings.finding: The Designers Guild licence (sole worldwide rights, manufactured at Anstey and Lancaster, immediate replenishment of best-sellers) is the first incremental brand volume since the period end and the interims are the first chance to quantify it or fold it into the outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Announced 2026-09-25 15:54; stock 73.0p -> 73.2p that day: no reaction.
